subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require default confirmation across Control UI, TUI, and Gateway/channel command surfaces, and should OpenClaw add any opt-out/config surface?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but the change alters documented command semantics across clients and the issue asks for new public config, so maintainer product intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` immediate, and defer config until there is stronger need for an opt-out.

options.title: Make confirmation configurable
options.body: Add confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting the schema, docs, and upgrade-policy burden.

options.title: Keep explicit commands immediate
options.body: Preserve typed slash commands as intentional destructive actions and limit confirmation to visible UI buttons or future non-command affordances.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` immediate, and defer config until there is stronger need for an opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged confirmation work and typed-command preservation decision are closest to the remaining product choice.
